readme:
# Pingram MCP

Hosted [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server for [Pingram](https://www.pingram.io). Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any MCP client, sign in with your Pingram account, and let an AI agent send notifications and manage your account on your behalf.

**Docs:** [pingram.io/docs/integrations/mcp](https://www.pingram.io/docs/integrations/mcp)

## Server URLs

Use the region that matches your Pingram account:

| Region | URL |
| ------ | --- |
| US (default) | `https://mcp.pingram.io` |
| Canada | `https://mcp.ca.pingram.io` |
| EU | `https://mcp.eu.pingram.io` |

## What you can do

After connecting, agents can:

- Send email and SMS
- Look up delivery logs by tracking ID
- Search, buy, and list phone numbers
- Manage sender domains and email inboxes
- Create accounts and manage US A2P 10DLC brand registrations

## Connect from Claude.ai

1. Open **Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector**.
2. Enter `https://mcp.pingram.io` (or your region’s URL).
3. Sign in to Pingram when prompted and approve access.

## Connect from ChatGPT

1. Add a custom MCP connector.
2. Use `https://mcp.pingram.io` (or your region’s URL).
3. Sign in to Pingram when prompted.

## Connect from Cursor

Add to your `mcp.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "pingram": {
      "url": "https://mcp.pingram.io"
    }
  }
}
```

Sign in to Pingram the first time Cursor connects.

## Authentication

- Sign in with the same Pingram account you use in the dashboard (email, Google, or Microsoft).
- No API key is required for the hosted connector.
- The agent acts as you, scoped to your Pingram account.
- To disconnect, remove the connector or sign out in your AI client’s settings.

## Registry

Published on the Official MCP Registry as [`io.pingram/mcp`](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/).

- Docs: https://www.pingram.io/docs/integrations/mcp
